name: Suspicious Hoofprints
summary: Hoofprints trail away from the smoking remains of the Shady Rest Inn. A few are easy to see, while others are nearly lost in the soft marsh mud. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore is the one to report them to.

sections.title: Prints in the Mud
sections.body: Rows of prints run off from the Shady Rest Inn, whose ruin is still smoking. A handful of the impressions are plain to see, while further rows are all but invisible in the marsh's soft mud. Captain Garran Vimes, in Theramore, should hear of them.

sections.title: What Vimes Makes of It
sections.body: Vimes remarks that a great deal of centaur activity is found in the lands near Dustwallow Marsh. Short trips into the Barrens turned up their camps and holdings scattered across the area. Vimes will send Falgran Hastil, one of the trackers, to learn where the prints lead.

faq.answer: They trail away from the Shady Rest Inn, which is still smoking, across the soft marsh mud.

faq.q: Who receives the report about the prints?
aliases: who do i tell about the hoofprints

faq.q: How easy are the prints to follow?
aliases: are the prints hard to see
faq.answer: A few are clear, but many more rows are nearly invisible in the mud.
